To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We have identified a novel mechanism for regulating serum levels of the protein, uPAR.
a genetic variation in the human plasma kallkikrein gene is associated with circulating scuPAR levels and that plasma kallikerein is responsible for the cleavage of scuPAR.
a genetic variant in the human plasma kallirein (KLKB1; rs4253238) gene is associated with serum uPAR levels in asthma and COPD.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of the molecular mechanisms that control the production and function of the soluble cleaved uPAR (scuPAR), and the identification of genetic variants that influence the production and function scuPAR.
the identification of genetic variants that influence the expression and/or activity of proteins that are associated with disease.
the discovery of novel genetic and bio-molecular mechanisms that regulate the soluble form of the urokinase receptor.
